about_heading: Holistic care in Richardson and Frisco
about_body:
Flourish Dental Boutique is a holistic and biological dental practice led by Dr. Toni Engram. The focus is on dentistry that accounts for the whole patient, from the materials used to the way treatment is planned.

Patients are now seen in Richardson and in Frisco. Both locations offer the same care: SMART amalgam removal, tongue-tie revision and sedation for the patients who need it.

services.name: Holistic and biological dentistry
services.blurb: Treatment planned around the whole patient, not just the tooth in front of us.

services.name: SMART amalgam removal
services.blurb: Safe mercury amalgam removal following the SMART protocol, with protection throughout.

services.name: Tongue-tie revision
services.blurb: Assessment and revision of tongue-tie for infants, children and adults.

services.name: Sedation dentistry
services.blurb: Sedation options for patients who find dental treatment difficult to sit through.

footer_tagline: Holistic and biological dentistry in Richardson and Frisco, Texas.
why_this_angle: Led on the holistic specialty and put both cities in the headline so the Frisco expansion from growth_trigger reads as one brand rather than two practices.
